question: What was the result of the Test series (February-March 2021) between India and England Men's cricket team?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India won 3-1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **England tour of India (February-March 2021)**__

 __
 
• A total of **4 test**,** 5 T20I** and **3 ODI** was held from **5th February **to **28th March 2021** in** India**.
 
• India won the Test series **3-1**, T20I series** 3-2** and ODI series** 2-1**.
 
• **R Ashwin** was given the** man of the series** for this** Test series**.
 
• Captain **Virat Kohli **was given the** man of the series** for this **T20I series**.
 
• **Jonny Bairstow** was given the** man of the series** for this **ODI series**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** ICC__**

 __
 
• The **International Cricket Council **(ICC), the international governing body of Cricket founded in **1909 **by representatives from **England**,** Australia**, and** South Africa**.
 
• It was initially known as the** Imperial Cricket Conference**.
 
• In **1965**, it was renamed as **International Cricket Conference**.
 
• it was renamed the** International Cricket Council **(ICC) in **1989**.
 
• Headquarters of ICC -** Dubai**, **UAE**
 
• Motto - **Cricket for good**
 
• Chairman -** Greg Barclay**
 
 
 
• **BCCI**__
 
 
• The full form of the BCCI is the **Board of Control for Cricket in India**.
 
• The board was formed in **December 1928** as a society, registered under the **Tamil Nadu Societies Registration Act**.
 
• BCCI is **an autonomous body** and does not review any grants or funding from the Sports Ministry of India.
 
• Present chairman of BCCI is** Sourav Ganguly**.
 
• The present secretary of BCCI is **Jay Shah**.
 
• The current President of **Asian Cricket Council **is **Jay Shah**.
